verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents a run inspector for finding and debugging errored runs, and run handles can be used to retry a run. Nothing shows a manual re-run resuming from the failing step rather than restarting the task. missing for 10: evidence of resume-from-failing-step on re-run, detailed docs on log inspection in the run inspector, hands-on corroboration of manual re-run from the dashboard.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can inspect past execution logs and re-run a failed execution, resuming from the failing step

citations.quote: Quickly identify queued, errored or waiting tasks and debug them using the run inspector.
You can use the handle to check the status of the task, cancel and retry it.
You can configure retrying in two ways: In your trigger.config file you can set the default retrying behavior for all tasks. On each task you can set the retrying behavior.
